_layer: POLICY (EXAMPLE). Copy to config/search.json and replace every value with your own. Same shape, neutral defaults. These read as personal but are parameters: swap them and the same playbook retargets a different city, level, and field with no prose edits.

level.equivalence_test: Director and Group PM count ONLY if they manage managers, or hold multi-team / company-critical scope, OR clear the comp floor below. Genuine single-team IC roles are out.
level.comp_floor_exception: If scope and domain are exceptional (e.g. early-stage GM-scope with real equity), a role below the floor may be surfaced - but the comp gap must be stated explicitly, never buried.

geography._rule: A HARD FILTER, not a preference. Discard other-metro hybrid/onsite, relocation-required, and remote-that-excludes the home state, even for exceptional domain fit.
accepts: remote that explicitly includes the home state

linkedin.metro_geo_id: <LinkedIn geoId for your metro - copy from a filtered search URL>

domains_priority: <expansion domain - volume, not a licence to stretch>
_domains_note: Ranked. The last three are volume expansion, not a licence to stretch.

cadence._full_scan_rule: A differential search filters for NEW postings within each source; it never skips whole sources or defers a tier to a multi-day rotation. If tight on time, scan every source shallower rather than dropping any.
cadence.first_tier_each_run: Tier B (home-metro HQ, hybrid) - clears the location bar by default and is easy to under-scan because those boards expose no JSON API
